scope: Independent review of native CW32L031/L052/R031/W031 DMA source evidence, current metadata, two-path generated delta, ordinary examples, ancillary capability disclosures and actual main compiler/linker artifacts.

source_evidence.selected_identity_rule: All selected source-node non-consumer identity fields remain strict, including archive own identity/provenance/license and selected member extraction chains. Selected node.evidence and embedded text.evidence are mutable consumer backlinks. Unused archive member catalogs are outside this finite dependency set.
source_evidence.source_index_delta: Exactly 54 selected evidence arrays received 162 references; reversal restored all 403846 baseline bytes. No immutable source identity or existing reference changed.

generated_delta.native_pac_change: Existing 59414-byte prefix remains identical; only a 429-byte native ICR reset/no-op helper suffix was appended. Both helpers return 4294967295. The new JSON exactly projects the authored eight-field R1W0 command.

retained_failure_history.cause: Selected extracted text nodes referenced a parent vendor artifact, but the checker attempted to read id from the text child.
retained_failure_history.correction: Resolve vendor source_ref against the source-index root artifact; retain exact selected-node identity comparison.

retained_failure_history.cause: The ledger intentionally contains clock facts; the existing sidecar also contains narrative notes/evidence.
retained_failure_history.correction: Exclude only top-level clock notes/evidence; compare all hardware, status/blocker and unknown fields strictly.

retained_failure_history.cause: L052 encodes fields with standard lsb/msb rather than bitOffset/bitWidth.
retained_failure_history.correction: Accept exactly either complete observed pair, normalize inclusive bounds, reject other/conflicting encodings and require valid 32-bit ranges.

main_results.actual_artifact_inspection: Retained primary archives contain ARM relocatable objects. Actual ARM ELF reset/Thumb entry, initial stack, executable text, allocated/load ranges, active interrupt vector words/strong non-default symbols, and selected exact memory.x all pass. Retained artifact, projection and log hashes agree.
main_results.post_main_source_correspondence: The only change after the terminal ARM matrix was the reviewed SVD field-encoding correction in tests/verify_dma_owned_evidence.py, from 9d749aa5584a7a229cabe9230e712d3ef9332259cf66570db6ec991b17b42ee1 to the final checker hash above. All compiled sources, examples, locks, configuration and generated files remain identical. Final finite source gates passed afterward.

clean_results: Not run or accepted at this main review. Final-package acceptance requires a separate source-only clean reconstruction with two standalone ARM libraries and four ELF links.
scope_limits: No new UART DMA RX, combined DMA UART, SPI DMA, other request consumer or borrowed hardware-request constructor.
Generic aliases remain missing-memory rejection; L031F8 UART1 safe-pin exclusions remain.
R031 whole-GPIOA and W031 RF functional handover constraints remain.
No hardware transfer, wire output, error injection, bus-drain timing, finite liveness, worst-case dynamic stack, RF continuity or electrical validation is established.
reviewer_actions: Read-only inspection and external review receipts only; no production edits, builds, generation, source gate execution, HAL tests, probes or models by this reviewer.
